name: The Tower
source:
You enter a mysterious tower shrouded in a sea of mist as a chosen soul. You gained access to become the next torturer.
You only have 6 days to get cleanse the sinful soul and get it through the trial. Otherwise, you will die yourself.
However, as you proceed deeper inside the tower, it seems that there are many more secrets hidden from within, and the so-called trial is not as simple as you think.
You will follow the story, and the characters within the story step by step to unlock the secrets of the tower. And make your own choice.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ319083.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
你作为一个被选中的灵魂进入一座笼罩在雾海中的神秘塔。你获得了成为下一个酷刑者的机会。
你只有6天的时间来净化罪恶的灵魂并通过考验。否则，你自己就会死。
然而，随着深入塔内，似乎里面隐藏着更多的秘密，所谓的试炼并不像你想象的那么简单。
你将跟随故事和故事中的人物一步步解开塔的秘密。并做出自己的选择。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ319083.html]DLsite[/url]]
